test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Name the famous Indian writer who has written novels like 'Untouchable' and 'Coolie'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mulk Raj Anand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mulk Raj Anand **(**1905 – 2004**) along with **R. K. Narayan **(**1906 – 2001**), **Ahmad Ali **(**1910 -1994**), and **Raja Rao **(**1908 – 2006**) are considered **pioneers **of **Indo-Anglian fiction**.
 
• He was **known **for his **depiction **of the **lives of the poorer castes **in **traditional Indian society **and was one of the first **India-based writers in English **to gain an **international readership**.
 
• **“Untouchable” **was the **first novel **written by **Mulk Raj Anand **published in **1935 **followed by **“Coolie” (1936) **and **“Two Leaves and a Bud” **(**1937**).
 
• He was **a recipient **of the **Padma Bhushan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kamala Surayya**, popularly known by **her one-time pen **name **Madhavikutty **and married name **Kamala Das**, was an **Indian poet **in **English **as well as an **author in Malayalam from Kerala**, **India**.
 
• **Rasipuram Krishnaswami Iyer Narayanaswami **was an **Indian writer **known for his work set in the **fictional South Indian town of Malgudi**. He was a **leading author **of early Indian **literature in English **along with **Mulk Raj Anand and Raja Rao**.
 
• **Anita Desai**, born **Anita Mazumdar **is an **Indian novelist **and the **Emerita John E. Burchard Professor **of **Humanities **at the **Massachusetts Institute of Technology**. As a writer, she has been **shortlisted **for the **Booker Prize three times.**
